knimeNode.name: Track Progress
knimeNode.shortDescription: Creates convergence summaries, Pareto metrics and exportable events.

fullDescription.intro: Reads objectives, directions, constraints, and optional hypervolume references automatically from Problem Setup. It reports scalar statistics, feasible counts, nondominated-set size, optional hypervolume and detailed per-individual events. Summary rows retain the configured series label, run seed, and problem identity for repeated-run analysis. The population passes through unchanged.

ports.outPort: Unchanged population for the next node.
One row per run and population.
